info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Pyrite Racket Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Pyrite Racket Details Management API enables businesses to create and manage detailed specifications for Pyrite rackets. This endpoint allows users to submit comprehensive information about new racket models, ensuring that inventory data is accurate and up-to-date. Typical consumers include product managers and inventory specialists who require a systematic way to introduce new products into their catalogs. The API streamline product onboarding, enhancing overall operational efficiency within inventory management workflows.

post.summary: Create details for a pyrite racket.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create detailed information for a pyrite racket. It enables the submission of various attributes and characteristics associated with the racket, facilitating better product management and inventory tracking.

requestBody.description: This request body should contain the necessary information to create or update the details of a pyrite racket. Ensure that all required fields are accurately filled to facilitate processing.

200.description: Request completed successfully and details have been retrieved.

CreateCatalogPyriteRacketDetailRequest.title: Pyrite Racket Request Body

pyrite_racket_id.description: The unique identifier for the Pyrite racket.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person making the request.

quantity.description: The number of racks being requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates if the request is a priority request.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Pyrite racket.
